visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit house entryway. A man wearing a grey puffer jacket and a woman in a red long-sleeved shirt stand facing each other near a dark wooden front door. Both characters exhibit stern, annoyed facial expressions with furrowed brows. The woman has her arms crossed tightly over her chest. (2) In a sudden shift of action, the couple leans in for a brief, robotic kiss. Immediately after, they pull back with exaggerated expressions of disgust and annoyance, maintaining their angry personas. The background shows a white wall and a cluttered shoe rack. (3) The man turns away and opens the front door, stepping out into daylight while maintaining a stiff posture. The woman remains standing in the hallway, looking away with a persistent scowl, her arms still crossed over her red shirt. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor living room with a grey fabric sofa. The woman sits on one end, staring at her phone with a grumpy look. The man sits next to her, holds a bright red apple, and forcefully crushes it into two pieces using his bare hands. He hands one half to her; she takes it and takes a bite while still looking annoyed. (5) Outdoors, the woman is sitting on concrete steps outside a sliding glass door, hunched over and shivering in the cold while eating the apple. The man appears from inside the house, carrying a dark olive green jacket, and drapes it around her shoulders. She looks up with a startled yet still grumpy expression. (6) At a white dining table, the couple eats from red Chinese takeout boxes. The man has a large smudge of sauce on his cheek. Without making eye contact, the woman aggressively grabs a white napkin and wipes the sauce off his face with a series of rough strokes. He looks slightly dazed. (7) In a white-tiled bathroom, the man sits on the toilet holding an empty cardboard toilet paper tube with a look of despair. The woman suddenly pushes the door open and hurls several full rolls of white toilet paper at him in quick succession. He flinches as they bounce off him.
